description: Poll the lightweight review status of a submitted software (progress, sub-step, rate-limit budget). Returns { tool_id, tool_status, awaiting_media, missing_media, presentation, next_step, version, review_job_status, review_sub_step, review_passed, rejection_reason, review_started_at, review_completed_at, rate_limit }. awaiting_media true means the tool is approved but not listed yet because screenshots are missing (missing_media). Polling: poll every 30 s until review_job_status is neither "queued" nor "running"; a full review takes 5-15 minutes. If review_passed is false after completion: call get_review_report for structured findings. rate_limit.updates_remaining_today shows the budget shared by set_metadata and new builds. Requires sign-in to your Crela account; your client asks you to connect when you first use it.
name: check_review_status
title: Check Crela review status
